=IFERROR(__xludf.DUMMYFUNCTION("{""STT"",""Devices"";
LET(
  devs,FILTER(
    $D$2:$D1000,
    $D$2:$D1000<>"""",
    $D$2:$D1000<>""CISCO-NETWORK-SUB"",
    $D$2:$D1000<>""CISCO-ROUT-SUB""
  ),
  raw,REDUCE(
    """",
    devs,
    LAMBDA(acc,dev,
      LET(
        def,XLOOKUP(dev,$T$"&"2:$T1000,$U$2:$U1000,""""),
        adv,XLOOKUP(dev,$T$2:$T1000,$V$2:$V1000,""""),
        sdn,XLOOKUP(dev,$T$2:$T1000,$W$2:$W1000,""""),
        ful,XLOOKUP(dev,$T$2:$T1000,$X$2:$X1000,""""),
        VSTACK(
          acc,
          IF(def<>"""", dev&"" "&"(Default Routing)"", """"),
          IF(adv<>"""", dev&"" (Adv Routing)"", """"),
          IF(AND(sdn<>"""", LOWER(TRIM(TO_TEXT(sdn)))<>""không có""), dev&"" (SDWAN)"", """"),
          IF(AND(ful<>"""", LOWER(TRIM(TO_TEXT(ful)))<>""không có""), dev&"" "&"(Full Adds On)"", """")
        )
      )
    )
  ),
  out,FILTER(raw,LEN(TRIM(raw))>0),
  HSTACK(SEQUENCE(ROWS(out)),out)
)}"),"STT")

=IFERROR(__xludf.DUMMYFUNCTION("{""Final Price"";
MAP(B2:B1000,
LAMBDA(b,
IF(b="""","""",
LET(
  dev,TRIM(REGEXEXTRACT(b,""^[^(]+"")),
  note,TRIM(REGEXEXTRACT(b,""\(([^)]+)\)"")),
  base,N(IFNA(XLOOKUP(dev,$D$2:$D1000,$E$2:$E1000),0)),
  plan,SWITCH(
    note,
    ""Default Routing"","&""""",
    ""Adv Routing"",IFNA(XLOOKUP(dev,$T$2:$T1000,$V$2:$V1000,""""),""""),
    ""SDWAN"",IFNA(XLOOKUP(dev,$T$2:$T1000,$W$2:$W1000,""""),""""),
    ""Full Adds On"",IFNA(XLOOKUP(dev,$T$2:$T1000,$X$2:$X1000,""""),""""),
    """"
  ),
  lics,IFERROR(
  "&"  FILTER(
      TRIM(SPLIT(REGEXREPLACE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(plan,CHAR(10),"" ""),CHAR(13),""""),""\s*\+\s*"",""|""),""|"",TRUE,TRUE)),
      LEFT(TRIM(SPLIT(REGEXREPLACE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(plan,CHAR(10),"" ""),CHAR(13),""""),""\s*\+\s*"",""|""),""|"""&",TRUE,TRUE)),4)=""LIC-""
    ),
    """"
  ),
  licSum,
    IF(
      COUNTA(lics)=0,
      0,
      SUM(
        MAP(
          lics,
          LAMBDA(lic,IFNA(VLOOKUP(TRIM(lic),{$F$2:$F1000,$G$2:$G1000},2,FALSE),0))
        )
      )
    ),
  base+licSu"&"m
)
)))
}"),"Final Price")
